Item #1: Researchers find that drugs like morphine and heroine may protect the brain from HIV associated dementia.
Item #2: A new study finds that late night video game playing significantly delays sleep onset in teenagers.
Item #3: Physicists create a true random number generator, exploiting quantum entanglement as the source of randomness.
